name: M3_PPS170MI_CrtPOP
description: Create new planned purchase orders in M3 directly from external planning tools, including Multi Site Planner integrations. The operation stores a planned purchase order in the live planning data based on warehouse, item, supplier, planning date, planned quantity, and status. M3 generates and returns the internal planned order identifiers, which are then used by other operations to retrieve, update, release, or delete the proposal. The same core business validations as standard planned purchase order maintenance apply, covering items, suppliers, order types, pricing, projects, seasons, and lot-controlled items.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse for which the planned purchase order is created.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number on the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Supplier number for the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Planning date when the planned purchase order affects material planning.

inputParameters.name: PPQT
inputParameters.description: Planned purchase quantity for the item on the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PSTS
inputParameters.description: Status code of the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PLPN
inputParameters.description: Internal number identifying the planned purchase order, optionally supplied when creating it.

inputParameters.name: PLPS
inputParameters.description: Subnumber identifying a specific part or line of the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PRCS
inputParameters.description: Service process linked to the planned purchase order for subcontract or repair purchases.

inputParameters.name: SUFI
inputParameters.description: Service ID tied to the subcontract or repair operation on the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: ORTY
inputParameters.description: Purchase order type controlling how the planned purchase order will be processed when released.

inputParameters.name: RESP
inputParameters.description: User ID responsible for the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: CUCD
inputParameters.description: Currency code used for the purchase price on the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: ODI1
inputParameters.description: First discount percentage applied to the planned purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: ODI2
inputParameters.description: Second discount percentage applied to the planned purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: ODI3
inputParameters.description: Third discount percentage applied to the planned purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: OURT
inputParameters.description: Type of internal reference number used on the planned purchase order, such as agreement or inquiry number.

inputParameters.name: OURR
inputParameters.description: Internal reference number connected to the planned purchase order, for example an agreement or inquiry number.

inputParameters.name: PPUN
inputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase price for the planned purchase order is expressed.

inputParameters.name: PUCD
inputParameters.description: Quantity that the purchase price applies to when calculating the price per unit.

inputParameters.name: PUPR
inputParameters.description: Purchase price per purchase price unit for the item on the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: MODL
inputParameters.description: Delivery method to be used for this planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: TEDL
inputParameters.description: Delivery terms agreed with the supplier for this planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PRIO
inputParameters.description: Priority of the planned purchase order used to rank its urgency.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Order category of the reference order linked to the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number, such as a customer or manufacturing order, linked to the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order linked to the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix on the reference order line linked to the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PITD
inputParameters.description: Item name as printed on the purchase order for this planned purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: PITT
inputParameters.description: Item description as printed on the purchase order for this planned purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: SITE
inputParameters.description: Item number used by the supplier for this item.

inputParameters.name: YRE3
inputParameters.description: Additional contact person (your reference) at the supplier for this planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number for the item on the planned purchase order, when lot-controlled.

inputParameters.name: PROJ
inputParameters.description: Project number to which the planned purchase order is linked.

inputParameters.name: ELNO
inputParameters.description: Project element within the project that the planned purchase order is linked to.

inputParameters.name: STRT
inputParameters.description: Product structure type associated with the item on the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: COCE
inputParameters.description: Cost center to which the costs of the planned purchase order are attributed.

inputParameters.name: PORQ
inputParameters.description: Purchase requisition number from which the planned purchase order originates.

inputParameters.name: RE20
inputParameters.description: Free reference text or code for the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PURC
inputParameters.description: User who requested or requisitioned the items on the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: BUYE
inputParameters.description: Buyer responsible for the planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PORG
inputParameters.description: Purchase organization used for purchase pricing or planning of this planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: SRAM
inputParameters.description: Supplier rebate agreement model applied to this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLPN
outputParameters.description: Internal number assigned to the created planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLPS
outputParameters.description: Subnumber assigned to identify the specific line or part of the created planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLP2
outputParameters.description: Secondary subnumber assigned for further identification of the created planned purchase order.
